data.revised_prompt:
Character design sheet for one standalone young Chinese Guochao xiqu / Chinese opera inspired styling character. Strict 16:9 horizontal image. Full body THREE VIEWS of the same character and same outfit: front view, side/profile view, back view, arranged left-to-right. Show full head-to-toe silhouette, hairstyle/headwear, sleeves, waist construction, skirt or pants structure, shoes, and back details. This is a fashion costume concept sheet, not a stage photo and not a scene.

Style direction: modern Chinese Guochao for ages 16-35, wearable, photogenic, boutique styling experience, refined fashion illustration / photorealistic concept art. Keep the traditional opera headwear silhouette as the foundation: fengguan, shuai helmet, huadan bead flowers, wudan lingzi, pearl tassels, black forehead hair patches, red pom-poms, enamel side ornaments, cloud motifs. Makeup is simplified modern beauty makeup: natural translucent skin, fine eyeliner, soft blush, clean red/peach lip, no white painted opera face.

Fashion background: clean contemporary fashion studio background, cool white and very light gray, subtle editorial gradient, soft floor shadow, faint modern display-panel feeling. Do NOT use yellow, beige, warm parchment, palace background, stage set, industrial scene, text labels, captions, watermark, logo, or extra people.

Clothing rules: modern short jacket, cropped top, small cloud collar, pankou buttons, embroidered gauze, detachable water-sleeve panels, pearl waist chains, clean boots or fashion sneakers. Do NOT use mamian skirt. Do NOT use stereotypical long new-Chinese robe. No gothic, no cyberpunk, no techwear armor, no samurai, no kimono, no bridal gown.

Design 41: Pants line. Seafoam-green huadan floral headpiece, pearl tassels and blue bead ornaments. Outfit: seafoam cropped jacket, ivory cloud collar, pankou, flowing white wide-leg trousers, pearl tassel belt, gauze sleeves, embroidered sneakers.

Important consistency: the three views must show the SAME character and SAME outfit, front/side/back only, full body, no labels or text. Background must feel cool, clean, modern fashion studio; avoid yellow or beige background.
